\begin{document}
The classical magnetization $\mathbf{s}$ and field $\mathbf{b}$ are vectors.
The precession torque is unchanged on exchanging the factors,
\begin{equation}
\mathbf{s}\times\mathbf{b} = \mathbf{b}\times\mathbf{s} .
\label{eq:cross-exchange}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
